source_run: GC head ablation, not original RIM training history
query_selection: Same frozen 25 queries per epoch, with the exact existing candidate pairs and randomized A/B order
rank_scope: Each model ranks the same recorded 32 candidates: forced target plus 31 mined non-targets; candidate index zero is not rank one
teacher_scores: Actual saved teacher scores used only to select ranked images; never exposed to GPT
blinding: Reference, instruction, anonymous A/B images and opaque case ID only; no model identity, score, rank, epoch or target label
question: Which image better fulfills the retrieval request, considering the reference and modification instruction?
both_satisfy_policy: Compare the degree, clarity and completeness of meeting instruction-relevant requirements; do not invent extra requirements
both_fail_policy: Choose the closer result by the importance and severity of instruction-related failures
weak_distinction_policy: Still make a forced A/B choice, record low confidence and explicitly acknowledge the weak evidence; do not fabricate a distinguishing feature
same_image_policy: Skip identical ID or identical decoded RGB pixels/dimensions; exclude from win-rate denominator
random_order: Reuse the original one-time random A/B order, without a swapped-order repeat
repeated_unordered_pairs: One fresh relative judgment per distinct pair; map the same decision to each rank's teacher/student roles
denominator: All completed different-image comparisons in each epoch/rank; includes low-confidence choices and pairs where both satisfy or both fail. Publish percentages only when the group is complete.
interpretation: Forced-choice GPT relative preference, not absolute instruction accuracy or a guarantee of teacher correctness
cache_policy: Reuse ranking artifacts only; new output directory, prompt, schema, stage and prompt version; no reuse of old judgments or API responses
